purpose: Confirm retrieval-profile quality and evidence-drift effects on a larger heterogeneous PiPi benchmark without tuning on the confirmation set.

amendments.reason: The pre-authoring corpus-capacity audit showed insufficient diversity for the original 3 x 80 allocation. Before any V2 query authoring or confirmation retrieval, the protocol was rebalanced to four source families and added harvested open-data catalogs as a first-class Data Space family.

pilot_exclusion.rule: Pilot P1 cases may inform the design but must not appear in the V2 confirmation set.

rules: Development queries may be inspected during benchmark construction and implementation debugging.
Confirmation queries must not be used to tune retrieval parameters, profile definitions, query wording, relevance thresholds, or corpus composition after confirmation evaluation begins.
All confirmatory statistical claims are computed on the confirmation split only.

language_relation.allocation_rule: Each of the 24 source-family x query-type cells contains 1 cross-language query among 2 development queries and 2 cross-language queries among 8 confirmation queries. Query and target-evidence language are recorded explicitly.

query_authoring_rules: Each query must have a documented information need before retrieval results are inspected.
Confirmation query wording is frozen before confirmatory profile results are viewed.
Avoid near-duplicate queries that differ only by punctuation, trivial word order, or one copied keyword.
A single evidence target may support multiple genuinely different information needs, but no target should dominate a cell.
Queries must be answerable from the frozen PiPi corpus at the time the benchmark snapshot is locked.
Cross-language queries must express the same information need in a language different from the primary language of the target evidence.
Open-data-catalog queries target harvested metadata records, not downloaded source payloads.
Sensor Hub queries target metadata evidence unless a separately versioned structured payload corpus is explicitly introduced by protocol amendment.

scale.2: clearly relevant supporting evidence but incomplete on its own
scale.1: topically related but insufficient or weak evidence

annotation.primary_judgment: All pooled candidates receive one human graded-relevance judgment.
annotation.double_annotation_sampling: Exactly 2 confirmation queries from each of the 24 source-family x query-type cells, stratified across language relation where possible.
annotation.agreement: Report ordinal agreement on the double-annotated subset and adjudicate disagreements larger than one relevance grade.

frozen_profiles.rule: No profile parameter may be changed under an existing profile ID. Any new profile requires a new immutable versioned ID and is exploratory unless added by a protocol amendment before confirmation results are inspected.

statistics.confidence_intervals: 95% paired bootstrap confidence intervals with 10000 query-level resamples
statistics.quality_profile_test: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test on per-query nDCG@10 for preregistered profile contrasts
statistics.multiple_comparisons: Holm correction across preregistered secondary profile comparisons
statistics.subgroup_analysis: Report descriptive estimates and bootstrap confidence intervals by source_family, query_type, and language_relation. Treat interaction modeling as exploratory unless amended before confirmation unblinding.
statistics.drift_quality_association: Spearman correlation between chunk-level churn/Jaccard drift and absolute per-query nDCG@10 change; confirmation split only.

snapshot_and_provenance.rule: The final V2 benchmark execution is bound to one frozen catalog_snapshot_hash, immutable retrieval profile hashes, benchmark file hashes, relevance-judgment file hash, and Git commit SHA.
snapshot_and_provenance.corpus_capacity_gate: Before any V2 query is authored, run the corpus-capacity audit. Each source family must meet the preregistered diversity threshold. If not, amend or expand the corpus before query authoring rather than after observing retrieval results.

stopping_and_amendment_rules: Do not alter the confirmation split after confirmatory retrieval results are inspected.
Protocol amendments must be committed with a reason before the affected confirmation results are viewed.
Implementation bug fixes that do not change profile semantics are allowed, but the fix and rerun must be documented.
Corpus changes after snapshot freeze create a new benchmark snapshot and cannot be mixed with the frozen confirmation results.
